- Initial release of the job-market-research skill.
- Provides JSON-based search and aggregation of job postings, hiring signals, and freelance gigs via the Crawlora API.
- Supports major boards (Indeed, Google/Amazon/Apple/Meta/Tesla careers) and nearly all major ATS providers (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.).
- Enables quick research on what any company is hiring for, their hiring velocity, and available freelance gigs on Upwork and Fiverr.
- Requires only a free Crawlora API key; results are normalized and paginated.
